Step 1: Determine offsets.  
Asia/Singapore in 1961: UTC+7:30.  
US/Eastern in 1961 (standard time): UTC-5.  

Step 2: Convert 15:00 Singapore time to UTC.  
UTC = 15:00 − 7:30 = 07:30 UTC same day.

Step 3: Convert UTC to US/Eastern.  
US/Eastern = 07:30 UTC + (-5) = 02:30 same day.

Step 4: Date unchanged (both Dec 1, 1961).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 02:30
